fields.description: The opaque identifier. A project is renamed, moved and rescoped over its life, so none of that may sit in its primary key.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: What this society calls the programme of work: Coastal Flood Response, National Blood Drive, Ramadan Food Distribution. Display only; nothing in this app reads it to decide anything.
fields.label: Project

fields.description: Where the project has got to. A closed set with a fixed transition table in deployment/services/project.py, for the same reason a deployment's status is code: each value means something the server acts on. Completed and Cancelled are terminal, because a project that ended is history and reopening it would silently change what its deployments were run under.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The organisational anchor, required at creation (ACC-02). The project belongs to this node and everything beneath it, and geo scoping decides who sees it. There are no unplaced projects: one would be invisible to every coordinator and reachable by nobody.
fields.label: Geo Node

fields.description: When the programme of work begins. A planning figure: a deployment carries its own dates and is what governs who served when.
fields.label: Start Date

fields.description: When the programme of work is expected to end. Must not fall before the start date.
fields.label: End Date

fields.description: What the project is for, in the society's own words. Printed at the head of every terms of reference written under it; never read by code.
fields.label: Summary

fields.description: Anything about this project that is not a field.
fields.label: Notes
